functions.name: _BlocksOutputBuffer_InitAndGrow
functions.docs:

allocated size growth step is:
1   32 KB       +32 KB
2   96 KB       +64 KB
3   352 KB      +256 KB
4   1.34 MB     +1 MB
5   5.34 MB     +4 MB
6   13.34 MB    +8 MB
7   29.34 MB    +16 MB
8   45.34 MB    +16 MB
9   77.34 MB    +32 MB
10  109.34 MB   +32 MB
11  141.34 MB   +32 MB
12  173.34 MB   +32 MB
13  237.34 MB   +64 MB
14  301.34 MB   +64 MB
15  429.34 MB   +128 MB
16  557.34 MB   +128 MB
17  813.34 MB   +256 MB
18  1069.34 MB  +256 MB
19  1325.34 MB  +256 MB
20  1581.34 MB  +256 MB
21  1837.34 MB  +256 MB
22  2093.34 MB  +256 MB
...

functions.name: _BlocksOutputBuffer_InitWithSize
functions.docs:
Initialize the buffer, with an initial size.
Check block size limit in the outer wrapper function. For example, some libs
accept UINT32_MAX as the maximum block size, then init_size should <= it.
On success, return allocated size (>=0)
On failure, return -1

functions.name: _BlocksOutputBuffer_Grow
functions.docs:
Grow the buffer. The avail_out must be 0, please check it before calling.
On success, return allocated size (>=0)
On failure, return -1

functions.name: _BlocksOutputBuffer_GetDataSize
functions.docs: Return the current outputted data size.

functions.name: _BlocksOutputBuffer_Finish
functions.docs:
Finish the buffer.
Return a bytes object on success
Return NULL on failure

functions.name: _BlocksOutputBuffer_OnError
functions.docs: Clean up the buffer when an error occurred.
